title: AI social media automation
desc: A topic and a publish time trigger the copywriting and a branded image card; a person approves each post before it is published.

card.lede: A form starts the run: Llama 3.3 writes the post and a branded 1080×1080 image is composed. Nothing is published until a person approves it.
points: Copy and image in one run
Human approval before anything goes out
Publish step for Facebook and Instagram, tested on mock endpoints
